verdict.rationale: CoreWeave documents Spot Node Pools that give pay-as-you-go, commitment-free access to bare-metal GPU capacity, with Capacity Finder to check placement availability across Zones. The pricing page also advertises burst Spot capacity. However, nothing in the evidence quantifies a discount versus on-demand or describes how and when spot nodes are reclaimed. Missing for 10: documented preemption/interruption semantics (notice period, eviction behavior), concrete spot discount figures, independent or hands-on corroboration.
